flashcard_questions.q: A series of exercises performed after physical activity to help the body return to its resting state.
A condition where blood collects in the veins of the working muscles after exercise, reducing blood flow to the brain and causing dizziness.
A type of stretching where a muscle is held in a lengthened position for 15–30 seconds without movement.

flashcard_questions.a: The process by which the body returns to its pre-exercise state, including repair of muscle tissue and removal of waste products.
A waste product produced during anaerobic respiration in the muscles, causing soreness and fatigue.
